official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about the Assam Movement :
I. The Assam Movement led by All Assam Students' Union (AASU) was started in the year 1983.
II. The objective of the Assam Movement is to identify the migrant people, protect and provide constitutional, legislative and administrative safeguards to the Bangladeshi Migrants in Assam.
III. The Assam Movement was officially ended on 15th August, 1989 after coming to an understanding with the Government of India which found official expression in the Memorandum of Understanding popularly known as the Assam Accord.
Which of the above given statements is/are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: The AASU-led Assam Movement (1979-1985) demanded detection and deportation of illegal (Bangladeshi) migrants and safeguards for the Assamese people; it ended with the Assam Accord of 15 Aug 1985.

statements.t: The Assam Movement led by AASU was started in 1983.
The objective was to identify migrants and provide constitutional, legislative and administrative safeguards to the Bangladeshi migrants.
statements.fact: Safeguards were sought for the Assamese people; migrants were to be detected and deported.

statements.t: The movement officially ended on 15 August 1989 with the Assam Accord.
statements.fact: The Accord was signed on 15 Aug 1985.

official_questions.rule: Assam: 1979 start, 1985 Accord (cut-off 24.3.1971), Clause 6 safeguards for Assamese.
